_about: The record of the cells gate of data/fx_untranslated_excluded.json (src/build_fx_untranslated_excluded.py): what it proves and does not prove, and how each of the 20 table_retranslated readings was tied to its cells. Keyed like the register. The loader does not read it and a run does not hash it: the register itself is a hashed input and holds none of this.
_rule_addition: A table is accepted as retranslated only through the cells gate described in _moved_cells_gate (what it proves and what it does not).

_moved_cells_gate.proves: For each of the 10 records whose reason is table_retranslated, for each of its two readers (20 readings), every figure the finding rests on is quoted verbatim from the reader's own cells text of the year t report or of the year t-1 report (an exact substring of that report's cells, not of the other's); it is tied to a row marked with one underwriting year (the snippet starts at the year marker, names no other year and holds no 'prior', 'earlier' or 'total' row), to a development age (a label just before the figure or, for a list of unlabelled values, a first age anchored by the reader's own words under that year's marker, in one row of the pair's series with no row break to a part that is not an age label, no other year number and no prior/earlier/total, or by the other arm's reading of the same filing, page, underwriting year, series and figure) and to a series (paid or net named in the snippet or the words before it back to the row's start; none named for the gross estimate); no figure is a percentage, an age label or part of a longer number, and no snippet is read from inside a parenthesis; at least three different cells (with '', 'estimate' and 'gross' one series, and no two pairs on one cell) or the reader's own reason for fewer are compared, all of underwriting years before t-1; and at least one pair differs by more than one unit in the last printed place, so that rounding alone cannot account for the move.
_moved_cells_gate.does_not_prove: That free-text notes can be parsed into a table. The readers' cells are notes, not a parsed table: a list of unlabelled values is put into the columns of the filing's table by the readers' own labels, and the alignment rests on the two independent readers (the X-arm and the Y-arm) and on the hand check recorded here. The gate does not prove that either reader read a printed cell correctly (the filings' page images are not re-read by it), nor which of two alignments of the shifted 2016 rows of 1301/2016 X8 is the filing's (the entry records that as the analysis session's choice). Two limits found by review 6 (23 October 2026) remain, because refusing them would need a parse of the readers' notes that the notes do not support: (1) attack 9 D, a quote that anchors a list is tied to its year only through the last year marker before it in the reader's text, and the words between the marker and the quote are held to be one row of the pair's series; a row of another kind that no row break, year number, prior/earlier/total or paid/net word sets off from that marker (an unmarked row or another report's row joined to it by a comma) is not told apart; (2) attack A2, a figure that the reader quotes from another report inside the year t cells is refused when it stands inside a parenthesis, but not when the reader writes it with no parenthesis and no break before it.

checked_by_hand.what: each of the 20 readings (10 records, two readers each) was compared by hand with the reader's cells: that the figure, underwriting year, age and series of every pair are the cell's own
